data: Which line in the figure on the left has the highest F1 score at 20 authors?

The question asks for the line with the highest F1 score at 20 authors in the left graph. The left graph shows four lines representing different models: CNN-char, SCAP, CNN-word-word-char, and CNN-word-char. At 20 authors, the blue line (CNN-char) is the highest among all the lines. Therefore, the answer is the blue line labeled "CNN-char".
